summary.text: Daniel Fitzpatrick is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Denise DeDe-Poulin.
He previously represented Strafford 19 from 2022 to 2024 and has worked as a city manager.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Fitzpatrick's birthplace as New York and his profession as city manager.
His career experience includes work as a city manager in New York, New Jersey, Maine, Michigan and New Hampshire.
Fitzpatrick served in the New Hampshire House for Strafford 19 from 2022 to 2024 and was assigned to the House Executive Departments and Administration Committee for 2023-2024.
He ran for re-election in Strafford 19 in 2024 and was not elected.
